pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with jagged, high-angularity edge gradients on the neck and upper flank; transitioning to smaller, more rounded geometries with reduced spatial area toward the posterior flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological mesh. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial (Y-shaped). Corridor pixel thickness is minimal on the upper neck and increases significantly toward the mid-flank and ventral regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck line, characterized by short, erect individual hair structures visible against the background.
